versions.name: Bradley Scout Reservation
versions.address: Bradley Scout Reservation, near Stanley, ID

features.note: An overnight backpacking trek into the Frank Church-River of No Return Wilderness.
A new climbing tower and climbing wall.
The Big Catch, an advanced fishing programme built around the Complete Angler recognition.
The Adventure Experience, a multi-day track of paddleboarding, whitewater, trekking, and climbing.
Paddleboarding on a high alpine lake.
Swimming and instructional swim take place at a heated pool called the Plunge.
Boating runs on the largest of the Cape Horn Lakes.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp in Stanley, Idaho, offering a mountain outdoor program.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
